metrics.label: Value
metrics.desc: Points above a replacement-level player (EPA for skill positions, box points for defence and specialists)

metrics.label: EPA/play
metrics.desc: EPA per credited play at the player's position

metrics.label: Targets
metrics.desc: Targets parsed from the play text

metrics.label: Dropbacks
metrics.desc: Dropbacks credited from the play-by-play (garbage time excluded)

metrics.label: EPA/dropback
metrics.desc: Expected points added per dropback, sacks and interceptions included

metrics.label: Dropback success
metrics.desc: Share of dropbacks that gain expected points

metrics.label: Runs/game
metrics.desc: Designed runs and scrambles per game (style)

metrics.label: Rush success
metrics.desc: Share of carries that gain expected points

metrics.label: Rush share
metrics.desc: Share of the team's carries in his games

metrics.label: Target share
metrics.desc: Share of the team's targets thrown his way in his games

metrics.label: Target success
metrics.desc: Share of targets that gain expected points

metrics.label: Yds/team att
metrics.desc: Receiving yards per team pass attempt in his games

metrics.label: Havoc/game
metrics.desc: Tackles for loss, passes defended, interceptions and hurries per game

metrics.label: Inside 20
metrics.desc: Share of punts downed inside the 20

metrics.label: Sack rate
metrics.desc: Sacks per dropback: the most quarterback-driven part of protection

metrics.label: Yds/dropback
metrics.desc: Yards per dropback after sack losses

metrics.label: QB rush EPA
metrics.desc: Expected points added per quarterback run (designed runs and scrambles)

metrics.label: Stuff rate
metrics.desc: Share of carries stopped for no gain or a loss

metrics.label: FGA/game
metrics.desc: Field-goal attempts per game (how much his coach uses him)

metrics.label: Long FG
metrics.desc: Longest made field goal of the season
